specs.name: Display
specs.value: 7 Inch LCD, 1024*600 Pixel, 250nit Brightness by default (400 nit optional)

specs.name: Touch
specs.value: Five Point Capacitive touch, Covered with Amorplate Glass (Or Reisistive Touch);

specs.name: Audio
specs.value: On board Speaker(1W), 1 Audio out, 1 Mic In Connector (Can change to Line in by changing resistor)

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: Use Battery CR1220, Not Mounted by default.

specs.name: KEY
specs.value: 5 User defined keys, 1 Reset Key, 1 Power Key
